title: HONOR 300 Pro device identity metadata
description: Device identity only: replays the SystemInfo android_build_fingerprint, android_device_manufacturer, android_soc_model, android_sdk_version that a HONOR 300 Pro capture recorded, over the android-startup-light real base. It is not a HONOR 300 Pro trace: apart from this identity and the case marker slice, every packet comes from the base.
known_issues: Derived metadata, not a device trace: only android_build_fingerprint, android_device_manufacturer, android_soc_model, android_sdk_version come from the HONOR 300 Pro capture; processes, scheduling, slices and all other metadata belong to the android-startup-light base.
The source capture is kept outside this repository. Its device serial number and every other per-unit identifier were removed; only build-level identity is kept.

android.device: HONOR 300 Pro identity over Google raven base
